name: Shinju Aster
source:
"There are many things in this world better left unsaid."

Mother of Subaru and Tanabata. Feared and respected by those around her as the Great Holy Mother. She carries herself with grace and values tradition as a conservative.

[Translated from [url=https://www.primula.jpn.com/qualiadelta/chara01.html]the official website[/url].]
